parameters.query: SELECT s.ship AS Shipment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [T_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbPedidos] p WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(p.cdbNumPedCliente)) = s.ship) AS Pedidos_igual_NumPedCliente, (SELECT SUM(p.cdbImporte) FROM [T_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbPedidos] p WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(p.cdbNumPedCliente)) = s.ship) AS Importe_NumPedCliente, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [T_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbPedidos] p WHERE p.cdbNumPedCliente LIKE '%' + s.ship + '%') AS Pedidos_like_NumPedCliente, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [T_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbPedidos] p WHERE p.cdbPickUpRef LIKE '%' + s.ship + '%') AS Pedidos_PickUpRef, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [T_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbPedidos] p WHERE p.cdbDropOffRef LIKE '%' + s.ship + '%') AS Pedidos_DropOffRef, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [T_DIANIA].[dbo].[tdbPedidos] p WHERE p.cdbAlbaran LIKE '%' + s.ship + '%') AS Pedidos_Albaran FROM (VALUES ('2684590'),('2693687'),('3106353'),('3109161'),('3111255'),('3111259'),('3111262'),('3112594'),('3113053'),('3113724'),('3114518'),('3117257'),('3117259'),('3117260'),('3117665'),('3118569'),('3119145'),('3119146'),('3120324'),('3120399'),('3121527'),('3122150'),('3122538'),('3128365'),('3129293'),('3129711'),('3130008'),('3130412'),('3130769'),('3131784'),('3132883'),('3133067'),('3134898'),('3135509'),('3135511'),('3135639'),('3138799'),('3140292'),('3140653'),('3141169'),('3142671'),('3143945'),('3145275')) AS s(ship) ORDER BY s.ship
